Claim-level printed-page binding is not yet complete for any of the 29 matrix rows.
Provider metadata does not currently expose a SHA-256 checksum for the inspected Drive PDFs; SHA-256 remains required before Pass 2.

narrow_gateway.rationale: B01 has authenticated curriculum mapping, Pass-1 multi-reference source population, at least two institutionally corroborated NCTB-approved textbook families, and authoritative scientific cross-checks. Exact scan edition identity and claim-page binding are still blocked, so only non-publishable shadow drafting may proceed.
narrow_gateway.sunset_condition: This gateway closes for B01 when one additional reference reaches exact-scan edition authentication + reproducible SHA-256/custody + claim-level printed-page binding, followed by independent Pass 2.

preferred_resolution_route.rationale: The established LBFL evidence model already allows reproducible physical-copy identity as an alternative to digital SHA-256. This avoids blocking the curriculum indefinitely on an image-only or connector-limited PDF while preserving exact-edition and page-level evidence.

invariant: The narrow gateway creates preparation authority only. It must never be interpreted as evidence completion, publication authority, Pass-2 success, or a substitute for exact-edition/page/hash evidence.

artifact_identity_routes.rule: Pass 2 may use exactly one reproducible artifact-identity route. Digital PDF evidence requires SHA-256 of the exact inspected bytes. A maintainer-owned physical-copy route may substitute for an unavailable PDF hash only when the exact book identity and custody are reproducible and every cited printed page is captured as a hashed page image.

physical_copy.rule: The physical-copy route does not authenticate an unrelated digital scan. The physical book itself becomes the inspected primary artifact; the PDF may remain supplementary.
